title: Two-block planar mate with DOF inspection
task: Create project 'eval-assembly'. Create two boxes: Anchor 60×40×10 and Mover 30×30×12 as separate bodies. Create an assembly, define a component for each body, create instances a1 and b1. Ground a1 with fix_instance. Apply mate_faces between a1.top_face and b1.bottom_face. Call inspect_assembly and report remaining DOF for the moving instance. Call check_interference. Export the assembly. Do not add redundant constraints.
